_readme: Path → spec rules for scripts/e2e-affected.ts with TARGET=extension (the extension PR e2e tier). The specs under e2e/tests are not co-located with the code, so every narrowing is a rule here: a changed extension path that matches no rule runs the whole suite, which is the honest default for nine files that all onboard a wallet through the same fixtures (e2e/fixtures, e2e/utils, the onboarding feature, packages/wallet). A rule with an empty `specs` list says the path cannot reach any spec: use it only for a feature no spec drives and no fixture passes through (the onboarding helper every spec uses walks the unitag claim and recovery-phrase screens, so those features are not on this list). `ignore` lists paths that cannot reach the extension bundle at all, plus the locale files, English included: a changed string can only break a spec that asserts on the old text, which is a test to update, not a product regression, and the scheduled suite reports it the same day. `unstable` withholds specs that are flaky on the scheduled record and `broken` withholds specs red on every run (none yet in either; the [e2e] Tier lists refresh workflow fills both weekly from the scheduled runs' merged reports, `pinned` names entries it must never remove, and a stale entry fails the selector). The selector, its tests and this file are never ignored: changing them runs the full suite.
